lines.zh: 熔岩从我身侧淌过，像温水一样慢。
lines.en: Lava slides past my flank, slow as warm bathwater.

lines.zh: 我沿着黑石岸游，鳞片刮出细痕。
lines.en: I swim along the blackstone shore, scales scraping thin lines.

lines.zh: 三条同类在前，我跟上最后那条的尾。
lines.en: Three of my kind ahead; I follow the last one's tail.

lines.zh: 热浪推着我走，我几乎不用摆尾。
lines.en: Heat waves push me along; I barely need to flick my tail.

lines.zh: 我横穿岩浆海，身体一点点发灰。
lines.en: I cross the lava sea and my body slowly turns grey.

lines.zh: 鱼群散了，我追最近的那一条。
lines.en: The school scatters; I chase the nearest one.

lines.zh: 我的鳍一开一合，把灼热吐出去。
lines.en: My fins open and close, breathing the searing heat out.

lines.zh: 身后的水面浮起一层淡黑的沫。
lines.en: A faint black froth rises on the water behind me.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁拐弯，尾巴擦过碎石。
lines.en: I hug the rock wall on the turn, tail brushing the gravel.

lines.zh: 别处的水太冷，只有这边够烫。
lines.en: Other waters run too cold; only this side is hot enough.

lines.zh: 我摆尾的节奏，和熔岩的泡泡一样。
lines.en: My tail beats in time with the lava's bubbling.

lines.zh: 越过一道岩浆流，我鳞上还冒着烟。
lines.en: Crossing a lava stream, smoke still rises from my scales.

lines.zh: 前面有条死鱼，我绕开它游。
lines.en: A dead fish lies ahead; I give it a wide berth.

lines.zh: 我们四条并排游，影子落在黑石上。
lines.en: We four swim abreast, shadows falling on the blackstone.

lines.zh: 我的鳞缝里渗出一点黑气
lines.en: A little black haze seeps from between my scales.

lines.zh: 岩浆在我下面慢慢翻身
lines.en: The lava slowly turns beneath me.

lines.zh: 一条同类靠过来，又游开去
lines.en: One of my kind drifts near, then away.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方，水色暗了一截
lines.en: The water darkens where I pass.

lines.zh: 我停在水里，鳃一张一合得很慢。
lines.en: I hold still, gills opening and closing very slowly.

lines.zh: 身上的感染在发亮，紫色闪了一下。
lines.en: The infection on my body glows purple for an instant.

lines.zh: 我不吃也不睡，只是悬着漂。
lines.en: I neither eat nor sleep; I simply hang and drift.

lines.zh: 水底的石子在动，是热气在推它们。
lines.en: The stones below shift, pushed by the rising heat.

lines.zh: 有东西碰了我的鳞，我没有动。
lines.en: Something touched my scales; I did not move.

lines.zh: 我记得自己从前是条会游的活鱼。
lines.en: I remember being a living fish that used to swim.

lines.zh: 腐烂的味道从我身上散进水里。
lines.en: A rotting smell drifts off me into the water.

lines.zh: 我把头塞进岩缝，那里更暖些。
lines.en: I tuck my head into a crevice where it is warmer.

lines.zh: 同类在我旁边打转，我懒得理它们。
lines.en: My kin circle beside me; I cannot be bothered with them.

lines.zh: 每一次呼吸，都带走一点生气。
lines.en: Each breath carries a little more life out of me.

lines.zh: 我看不了太远，只看得见一片红。
lines.en: I cannot see far; I only see a sheet of red.

lines.zh: 尾巴垂着，像一块被煮软的布。
lines.en: My tail hangs limp, like cloth boiled soft.

lines.zh: 这具身体在烂，可还没有烂透。
lines.en: This body is rotting, but not yet rotted through.

lines.zh: 安静下来的时候，我听见熔岩在低语。
lines.en: When it goes quiet, I hear the lava whispering.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，我浮上来看着你。
lines.en: You stand on the bank; I rise up to look at you.

lines.zh: 你的手离水面太近了。
lines.en: Your hand is much too close to the water.

lines.zh: 我眼里那点紫，是留给你的。
lines.en: That fleck of purple in my eye is meant for you.

lines.zh: 你在看一条鱼，鱼也在看你。
lines.en: You watch a fish, and the fish watches you back.

lines.zh: 别把手伸进来，我碰一下就够了。
lines.en: Do not reach in; one touch from me is enough.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在岩浆上，我看得清。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across the lava; I see it clearly.

lines.zh: 我很久以前记得人长什么样。
lines.en: I remember what people look like, from very long ago.

lines.zh: 你身上有活人的味道，很浓。
lines.en: You carry the smell of the living, very strongly.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，鳃边的水珠滴下去。
lines.en: I lift my head and water drips from my gills.

lines.zh: 别走开，我只是想靠得近些。
lines.en: Do not walk away; I only want to come closer.

lines.zh: 刀切进我的肉，流出的水是黑的。
lines.en: The blade cuts my flesh and black water runs out.

lines.zh: 我不叫，鱼是不会叫的。
lines.en: I do not cry out; fish do not cry out.

lines.zh: 这一剑把我劈成两半，我还在动。
lines.en: The sword halves me and I am still moving.

lines.zh: 疼，可是感染让我停不下来。
lines.en: It hurts, but the infection will not let me stop.

lines.zh: 我往岩缝里钻，那里刚好挤得进。
lines.en: I squeeze into a crevice that just fits me.

lines.zh: 你砍掉的鳞，在水里打着转。
lines.en: The scales you cut off spin in the water.

lines.zh: 血涂在石头上，紫得发亮。
lines.en: My blood smears the stone, bright purple.

lines.zh: 我退了两格，又转回来。
lines.en: I retreat two blocks and turn back around.

lines.zh: 再打下去，我就要散架了。
lines.en: A few more hits and I will come apart.

lines.zh: 你手上的刀，也沾了我的病。
lines.en: The blade in your hand now carries my sickness.

lines.zh: 你手里那条鱼，已经不新鲜了。
lines.en: That fish in your hand is no longer fresh.

lines.zh: 我闻到它了，鳃都张开了。
lines.en: I smell it; my gills have flared wide open.

lines.zh: 扔下来，别用手递给我。
lines.en: Drop it in; do not hand it to me.

lines.zh: 我游近了一点，只为那条鱼。
lines.en: I have swum a little closer, only for that fish.

lines.zh: 食物在我嘴里早就没有味道了。
lines.en: Food has had no taste in my mouth for a long while.

lines.zh: 可我还是得吃，这是本能。
lines.en: Yet I still must eat; it is instinct.

lines.zh: 你把桶举高，我就跟着上浮。
lines.en: Raise the bucket and I float up after it.

lines.zh: 别把手放在鱼旁边，我会咬错。
lines.en: Do not put your hand by the fish; I may bite wrong.

lines.zh: 我咬住它，喉咙里一阵腥。
lines.en: I bite down and gore floods my throat.

lines.zh: 再给一条，我就不追你了。
lines.en: Give me one more and I will stop following you.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，撞得我翻了个身。
lines.en: You step into the water and knock me onto my side.

lines.zh: 你的骨头贴着我的鳞，很凉。
lines.en: Your bone presses my scales, very cold.

lines.zh: 我被撞开，又慢慢游了回来。
lines.en: Knocked aside, I drift slowly back again.

lines.zh: 离我半格远，就已经够了。
lines.en: Half a block from me is already far enough.

lines.zh: 你身上的温度，隔着水传过来。
lines.en: Your warmth passes to me through the water.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的鳞掉了两片。
lines.en: That bump cost me two scales.

lines.zh: 我贴着你转，像在量你的大小。
lines.en: I circle against you, as if measuring your size.

lines.zh: 别推我，我身上不干净。
lines.en: Do not shove me; I am not clean.

lines.zh: 水被搅浑了，我们谁也看不清。
lines.en: The water muddies and neither of us can see.

lines.zh: 撞一次，感染就多传一分。
lines.en: Each collision passes a little more infection.

lines.zh: 我们从不结伴太久，只挨一会儿。
lines.en: We never pair for long; only a brief touch.

lines.zh: 熔岩边上，两条影子叠在一起。
lines.en: By the lava's edge, two shadows lie on top of each other.

lines.zh: 感染就是在这样的时候传下去的。
lines.en: This is when the infection passes on.

lines.zh: 我的同类也发着一样的紫光。
lines.en: My kin glows with the very same purple.

lines.zh: 产下的卵，不知道还能不能活。
lines.en: The eggs we lay: who knows if they will live.

lines.zh: 我们并排游了三格，然后散开。
lines.en: We swim three blocks abreast, then part.

lines.zh: 它认得我的味道，我也认得它的。
lines.en: It knows my smell, and I know its.

lines.zh: 两条病鱼，靠着彼此取一点暖。
lines.en: Two sick fish, taking warmth from each other.

lines.zh: 这一段水里，只有我们还成双。
lines.en: In these waters, only we still come in pairs.

lines.zh: 别看了，鱼的事不该被打扰。
lines.en: Look away; fish business should not be disturbed.

lines.zh: 有东西沉进水底，我过去顶它。
lines.en: Something sinks to the bottom; I go and nudge it.

lines.zh: 我用嘴碰了碰，它一动也不动。
lines.en: I touch it with my mouth; it does not move at all.

lines.zh: 熔岩把它的边烧成了黑块。
lines.en: The lava has burned its edges into black lumps.

lines.zh: 这块铁在水里发烫，我不碰。
lines.en: This iron is hot in the water; I leave it.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里，又吐了出来。
lines.en: I grip it in my jaws and let it fall again.

lines.zh: 是我的吗？水里没有人回答。
lines.en: Is it mine? No one in the water answers.

lines.zh: 东西卡在岩缝里，我拖了出来。
lines.en: It was stuck in a crevice; I dragged it free.

lines.zh: 它上面还留着活人的气味。
lines.en: It still carries the smell of the living.

lines.zh: 我顶够了，就让它沉回去。
lines.en: I have nudged enough; I let it sink back.

lines.zh: 这不算收藏，只是无聊罢了。
lines.en: It is not a collection, only boredom.

lines.zh: 你下水的那一刻，我就盯住了。
lines.en: The moment you enter the water, I fix on you.

lines.zh: 不是饿，是身上这东西要我靠近。
lines.en: Not hunger; the thing inside me wants me near.

lines.zh: 我认出你了，你是活的东西。
lines.en: I have picked you out: something alive.

lines.zh: 鳞下的紫光转向了你的方向。
lines.en: The purple under my scales turns toward you.

lines.zh: 同类都躲开了，只有我迎上去。
lines.en: My kin all scatter; only I swim at you.

lines.zh: 目标很小，但对我来说够了。
lines.en: The target is small, but enough for me.

lines.zh: 你踩水的声音，我听得清清楚楚。
lines.en: I hear the sound of you treading water quite clearly.

lines.zh: 我开始绕圈，先封住你的退路。
lines.en: I start circling, cutting off your way back.

lines.zh: 这条水道，我比你熟得多。
lines.en: I know these channels far better than you.

lines.zh: 别上岸，上了岸我就没办法了。
lines.en: Do not climb out; out of water I am helpless.

lines.zh: 我贴着你游，鳍几乎碰到你。
lines.en: I swim alongside you, fins almost touching.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我听出来了。
lines.en: Your breathing has gone uneven; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我不着急，熔岩会替我等你。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the lava will wait for you.

lines.zh: 你往左，我就跟着往左。
lines.en: You go left, and I go left with you.

lines.zh: 每一次我靠近，你就退半步。
lines.en: Each time I close in, you step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 紫光越来越亮，我压不住了。
lines.en: The purple glow brightens; I cannot hold it back.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边转，鳞刮着你的靴。
lines.en: I circle your feet, scales scraping your boots.

lines.zh: 再近一格，我就扑上去。
lines.en: One more block and I lunge.

lines.zh: 你看不见水下的我，但我一直都在。
lines.en: You cannot see me under the water, but I am always there.

lines.zh: 别转身跑，鱼游得比人快。
lines.en: Do not turn and run; a fish swims faster than a man.

lines.zh: 我整个身子撞上去，鳞先着。
lines.en: I slam my whole body in, scales first.

lines.zh: 咬住你的小腿，牙小但很密。
lines.en: I bite your calf; my teeth are small but many.

lines.zh: 你皮肤上留下了五个紫点。
lines.en: Five purple dots are left on your skin.

lines.zh: 血混进水里，我的鳃张开了。
lines.en: Blood mixes into the water and my gills open wide.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，可感染进去了。
lines.en: The blow is light, but the infection got in.

lines.zh: 我松口，退开，再撞一次。
lines.en: I let go, back off, and strike again.

lines.zh: 你把我甩开，我在水里翻了个身。
lines.en: You throw me off and I tumble in the water.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬不动甲，咬得动布。
lines.en: My teeth cannot bite armor, but cloth gives way.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，你的皮肤会发痒。
lines.en: After this, your skin will begin to itch.

lines.zh: 我撞得太狠，自己也在发抖。
lines.en: I strike so hard that I am trembling too.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆里浮上来，身上还冒着烟。
lines.en: I rise out of the lava, still smoking.

lines.zh: 四条一起出生，挤在一条岩缝里。
lines.en: Four of us born together, crowded in one crevice.

lines.zh: 这片熔岩海，从来没有过鱼。
lines.en: This lava sea has never held fish before.

lines.zh: 睁眼的第一件事，是闻到血肉。
lines.en: The first thing I smell on opening my eyes is flesh.

lines.zh: 下界的火伤不了我，只会让我发灰。
lines.en: Nether fire cannot hurt me; it only greys me.

lines.zh: 我一出生就带着这一身病。
lines.en: I was born carrying this sickness.

lines.zh: 水面裂开一道口子，我钻了出来。
lines.en: A gap opens in the surface and I slip through.

lines.zh: 上面是黑石，是烟，是没有太阳的天。
lines.en: Above are blackstone, smoke, and a sunless sky.

lines.zh: 同类在等我，我们排成一小队。
lines.en: My kin wait for me; we form a small line.

lines.zh: 记住我现在的样子，再看就不同了。
lines.en: Remember how I look now; next time it will differ.

lines.zh: 火对我没用，我本来就住在火里。
lines.en: Fire does nothing; I already live inside fire.

lines.zh: 被抛上岸，我拍着地面直喘。
lines.en: Flung onto the bank, I slap the ground and gasp.

lines.zh: 水太多了，我的鳃反而不够用。
lines.en: Too much water, and my gills cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀起来，又摔进岩浆。
lines.en: The blast lifts me and drops me back into lava.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的鳍，钉在身后的岩上。
lines.en: An arrow through my fin pins me to the rock.

lines.zh: 魔法的光烫得我鳞片发白。
lines.en: Magic light burns my scales pale.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西也饿不死，只是更空。
lines.en: I cannot starve; I only grow emptier.

lines.zh: 雷电落进熔岩，我们整群翻白。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the lava and our whole school rolls over.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有熔岩，我冷得发僵。
lines.en: In the void there is no lava; I stiffen with cold.
